title: Find an authorised child restraint fitting station
summary: Find information and authorised stations to ensure your child is safely fastened in the correct car seat for their age and size.
intro:
All children must be safely fastened in the correct child car seat (booster seat) for their age and size.

The Centre for Road Safety provides information on national child restraint laws, and your legal obligations when travelling in a car with a child.
